---
id: homing-pigeon
title: Homing pigeon
---
Domestic homing pigeons (*Columba livia*) return to a loft from unfamiliar
release sites. Behavioural work implicates an inclination compass: birds
detect the angle of geomagnetic field lines, with a radical-pair reaction
in retinal cryptochrome and, in some models, magnetite along the beak.
Clock-shift tests rotate vanishing bearings as if a sun cue and this
inclination map were combined.
